FIFA’s Golden Boot is awarded to the player with the most goals at the end of the tournament. France’s Mbappe is the current holder after scoring eight goals in Qatar at the 2022 World Cup. If two players are tied on the same number of goals at the end of the tournament, then the player with the most assists will win the award. If those tiebreakers cannot split two players, then the Golden Boot is handed to the player who achieved their goals and assists in the least number of minutes. questions.title: Which national team will win the third-place playoff at the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup?
questions.background: The third-place playoff is contested by the two teams eliminated in the semifinals.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official result for the 2026 Men's World Cup third-place playoff. Resolution : Resolve to the winner of the third-place playoff, scheduled for July 18, 2026, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
questions.current_reasoning: Germany's and Netherlands' R32 eliminations plus France's 3-0 win over Sweden push France's Reach-Semifinal probability from 49.5% to ~70%, making France the new #1 favorite to win the third-place playoff (Match 103): even winning ~69% of SF1 matches, France lands in the third-place game ~22% of the time as heavy Elo favorites (~70% win rate), lifting France +4% from 11.5% to 15.5% across all simulation runs (15.2%-16.1%). Spain rises +1% (11% -> 12%) as a harder SF1 against France increases Spain's probability of dropping into the bronze match, Argentina trims slightly 12.5% -> 12%, England holds 8.5%, and Brazil trims 8.5% -> 8% after Norway booked the R16 tie, leaving 44% for Portugal (~7%), Morocco (~4.9%), Colombia (~4.5%), Norway (~3.4%), and the field.
